checks.name: unit-tests
checks.risk: Low: unit behavior passed for this revision.
checks.reviewerAction: Confirm the unit-test artifact digest and result.
checks.rollback: Revert the PR commit if later regression evidence appears.

checks.name: checkout-smoke
checks.risk: High: checkout cannot complete in the smoke scenario.
checks.reviewerAction: Block merge until the smoke failure is explained and corrected.
checks.rollback: Do not deploy; if already deployed, revert the checkout change.

checks.name: ui-screenshot
checks.risk: Medium: a screenshot proves rendering but not successful checkout.
checks.reviewerAction: Compare the screenshot with the expected checkout state.
checks.rollback: Revert the UI change if the visual state is not approved.
